name: Fujisaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fujisaki town emblem in purple, yellow and red: a purple stylised human figure with a yellow stroke, on a red ring.
history: Municipal flag of Fujisaki, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 September 2005.

features.role: Fujisaki town emblem — a purple stylised human figure with a yellow stroke, on a red ring
